title: Share one naming-authority reader-selection helper between settlement and recover_engram_authority_batch_until
outcome: acceptance_evaluation_authority_reader_available (src/engram_source_roots.rs) and recover_engram_authority_batch_until (src/engram_root_authority.rs:855-870) choose an authority reader (a binding target with authority_store_key == store and a routing token) through one shared helper, so the two cannot drift apart.
acceptance: Both call sites use a single helper for reader selection, and the existing settlement and recovery tests still pass.
